english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for biological life, existence, lifespan in general, or a loved one described as someone’s life.

exampleSentences.english: This discovery made me appreciate the value of life again.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個發現令我重新感受到生命嘅可貴。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 faat3 jin6 ling6 ngo5 cung4 san1 gam2 sau6 dou3 sang1 ming6 ge3 ho2 gwai3

english.note: Use 生命 for the state or fact of being alive, rather than for living people or a lifestyle.

exampleSentences.english: Living is precious, so we should cherish every day.
exampleSentences.traditional: 生命好寶貴，我哋要珍惜每一日。
exampleSentences.jyutping: sang1 ming6 hou2 bou2 gwai3 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zan1 sik1 mui5 jat1 jat6

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for life or the fact of being alive, rather than for abstract existence alone.

exampleSentences.english: Being alive is very important to me.
exampleSentences.jyutping: sang1 ming6 deoi3 ngo5 lei4 gong2 hou2 zung6 jiu3
